email.subject: Orbitale: next step for the Frontend Engineer role
email.body:
Hi,

Congratulations on passing the technical round for the Frontend Engineer role! The panel gave very positive feedback on your component design and testing approach.

We would like to invite you to the final interview, a conversation with our CTO about product thinking and how you work with designers. Our recruiting coordinator will contact you in the next few days to agree a time that suits you.

Well done so far, and speak soon.

Best,
Lucas Ferreira
Engineering Manager, Orbitale
